05 / lab notebook conclusion

What did we learn?

Channel length is the big lever.

Across all four model cards, increasing channel length made the inverter slower. Higher VTH0 usually increased delay. TOX and channel-doping changes had smaller effects and depended on the model card.

Always read the trend in the context of its model card.

SIMULATION
SUMMARY
Important note about NCH

The 180 nm report presents a direct NCH sweep. The 65 nm, 90 nm, and 130 nm reports describe an NDEP proxy for the requested NCH sweep. This notebook keeps those labels distinct so the results are not mistaken for the same measurement.
